news.headline: Lilly Left Nektar Drug 'Damaged Goods,' Jury Told At Trial End
news.summary: In closing arguments in the ~$1 billion breach-of-contract trial, Nektar's counsel told a California federal jury that Eli Lilly turned rezpegaldesleukin into 'damaged goods' by breaching their co-development deal and delaying it in favor of a competing drug Lilly later acquired. The jury began deliberations after closings, and no verdict had been returned as of September 21.

news.headline: BTIG Reiterates Buy Rating on Nektar Therapeutics, Maintains $178 Price Target
news.summary: BTIG reissued its Buy rating and $178 price target on Nektar shares, citing confidence in the rezpegaldesleukin alopecia areata and atopic dermatitis data package ahead of the pending REZOLVE-AA durability readout.

news.headline: Nektar Enters Quiet Period Ahead of REZOLVE-AA 24-Week Off-Treatment Data as Eli Lilly Trial Opens
news.summary: Nektar disclosed it entered a quiet period beginning September 8, 2026 through the public announcement of 24-week off-treatment (durability) data from the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA alopecia areata study, the same week its breach-of-contract trial against Eli Lilly opened in federal court.

news.headline: Nektar Announces Publication in The Lancet of Positive Phase 2b REZOLVE-AD 16-Week Induction Results
news.summary: Peer-reviewed efficacy, safety and biomarker data from the 16-week induction period of the REZOLVE-AD atopic dermatitis study were published in The Lancet, reinforcing the case for the ongoing Phase 3 ZENITH AD registrational program.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Nektar reported cash and investments of $1,023.4 million as of June 30, 2026 (up from $245.8 million at year-end 2025) after a $350 million public offering, and raised its year-end cash forecast to $815-$840 million while advancing Phase 3 trials.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Announces Start of Phase 3 ZENITH AD Program
news.summary: Nektar initiated ZENITH AD-1 and ZENITH AD-2, the first two of three global registrational Phase 3 trials of rezpegaldesleukin in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis, with a third trial (ZENITH AD-3) planned to start in September 2026.

catalysts.label: EADV 2026 Congress presentation (Vienna)
catalysts.detail: Nektar is scheduled to present REZOLVE-AA 52-week alopecia areata data at the European Academy of Dermatology and Venereology congress.

catalysts.label: REZOLVE-AA 24-week off-treatment (durability) data readout
catalysts.detail: Topline durability data from the blinded off-treatment follow-up of the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA alopecia areata study; company is in a quiet period ahead of this disclosure.

catalysts.label: Nektar v. Eli Lilly jury verdict
catalysts.detail: California federal jury is deliberating a ~$1 billion breach-of-contract claim over Lilly's co-development of rezpegaldesleukin; closing arguments concluded September 18, 2026 with no verdict yet reported.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 Phase 3 trial initiation
catalysts.detail: Third registrational Phase 3 atopic dermatitis trial (for patients with prior biologic/JAK inhibitor exposure) planned to begin enrollment.

catalysts.label: Planned start of registrational Phase 3 alopecia areata trial
catalysts.detail: Single registrational Phase 3 study in alopecia areata planned to begin, building on REZOLVE-AA Phase 2b results.

catalysts.label: Initial Phase 3 ZENITH AD data (atopic dermatitis)
catalysts.detail: First readouts expected from the ZENITH AD Phase 3 program in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis.

pulse: Nektar is at a pivotal moment: a California federal jury is deliberating its roughly $1 billion breach-of-contract suit against Eli Lilly over rezpegaldesleukin's co-development, with no verdict yet as of September 21, while the company sits in a quiet period ahead of critical Q4 REZOLVE-AA durability data. Sell-side sentiment remains strongly bullish (BTIG Buy, $178 PT) on the strength of positive Phase 2b atopic dermatitis (published in The Lancet) and alopecia areata results, and the balance sheet was bolstered by a $350M offering to fund the newly launched Phase 3 ZENITH AD program. The stock has pulled back roughly 12% over the past month amid litigation and data-readout uncertainty, leaving the Lilly verdict and REZOLVE-AA durability data as the two binary near-term catalysts to watch.
